reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by TanStack Table (https://tanstack.com/table/latest).
Technology stack: react, javascript, typescript.
Component specification: 最后开 React Quick Start：安装命令和 useTable 源码。

Visual details from source observation: 打开 tanstack.com/table/latest，大字 TABLE，副题 headless engine for building Data Grids，右侧 Issue Workbench 演示表。Overview 写它不是 AG Grid 那种现成组件，而是无样式引擎。Quick Start 给 npm install @tanstack/react-table 和 useTable 示例。本条只收 Table，不是整个 TanStack。MIT。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
